behavior_constraints: CG and GMRES must report residual as the true relative residual ||b - A*x_final|| / ||b|| recomputed after the solve, not the internal estimate.
After the converged, iterations, and residual output lines, print a fourth line true_residual with the absolute true residual norm ||b - A*x_final|| in scientific notation.
The residual line must continue to show the relative true residual; true_residual must show the absolute true residual norm.
Convergence history lines must be iteration_number tab true_relative_residual, starting with iteration 0 for the initial guess and one line per completed iteration.
Each history true_relative_residual must be ||b - A*x_k|| / ||b|| for the iterate x_k at that step.
--ssor-omega must be validated to lie in the open interval (0,2); otherwise print error: ssor-omega must be in (0,2) to stderr and exit with code 1.
The convergence reporting changes must apply to sparse-solve, poisson, and any command using iterative solvers; existing dense-solve, sparse-solve, and poisson commands must continue to work.

A new heat command must support the specified CLI options including --nx, --ny, --x0, --x1, --y0, --y1, --alpha, --dt, --nsteps, --scheme, --ic, --source, four --bc-* options, --solver, --precond, --tol, --maxiter, optional --restart, optional --ssor-omega, and --output.
The heat solver must support backward-euler and crank-nicolson schemes using the specified formulas with the same stiffness matrix K as the Poisson solver.
K must be the unmodified Poisson stiffness matrix; Dirichlet rows must be applied to the time-stepping system matrix and RHS at every time step as identity rows with boundary values.
entities.summary: This round corrects iterative-solver convergence reporting to use true residuals with iteration-numbered history and SSOR omega validation, and adds a transient 2D heat equation solver with backward-Euler/Crank-Nicolson time stepping.

instruction_head:
Two changes this round: fixing a convergence reporting issue and adding a transient heat equation solver.

## Convergence Reporting Correction

The iterative solvers currently report only `residual: <value>` which is the relative residual `||r||/||b||`. This needs to be tightened:

1. **Both CG and GMRES must now report the true relative residual**, computed as `||b - A*x_final|| / ||b||`, not just the internal estimate. The internal estimate can drift from the true residual due to floating-poin
